capabilities: capture property values via a carousel modal, quick-add panel, obsidian:// links, and a grid view
visualize tracked properties as 13 chart types, heatmaps, tag clouds, and progress rings
overlay multiple properties on one chart to compare correlations
set goals with reference lines, running totals, and personal-record tracking
export charts as PNG and displayed data as CSV
extras: Some features (quick-add links, capture targets) are documented in a separate guide rather than the README; the author asks for support via GitHub Sponsors, Buy me a coffee, and a paid community. Installation via BRAT is described for pre-release versions.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin adds a "Life Tracker" Base View type
problem: Obsidian's Bases shows note metadata as tables but has no way to log tracked values quickly or render them as time-series charts and dashboards.

relations.evidence: if you use the Obsidian Starter Kit plugin, you don't have to define your properties twice
Periodic Notes: its daily folder, date format and template.
templates go through Templater exactly once

requires.name: Obsidian Starter Kit / Periodic Notes / Templater

summary: Bases-based life tracker that captures property values across notes and visualizes them as charts, heatmaps, progress rings, and a data-entry grid.
